The raw_customers table is an SCD2-style dimension. 30 customers have two rows, one current (is_current=True) and one historical (is_current=False). The join in gold_region_daily fans out those customers' transactions, which is why it reports 5415 against 4699.

Each customer has exactly one row with is_current=True (200 rows, 200 distinct customers). Filtering silver_customers to is_current produces exactly one row per customer.

The rule is not ambiguous: the current region is the one to use. A point-in-time join would be an alternative, but valid_from is either 2025-01-01 or 2023-06-01 and there is no valid_to. All transactions are in 2026, after both valid_from dates, so the current row applies to every transaction anyway.

Fix: filter silver_customers to is_current = true. This keeps the columns the same and leaves the gold step unchanged.
